fill: next H1 open after a signal on a closed H1. Forming last H1 excluded.
signals: Closed-bar H1 close-through of donchian_prior(N) only if ATR14/ATR50 at i-1 is squeezed and TR[i]/ATR14[i-1] expands. Both sides. No EMA/RSI/MACD/H4.
weekend: flatten_weekend frozen true. No new fill on Friday last H1. Open trades exit at that open. Swap unmodeled.

causality.completed_bars: Range, squeeze, and setups use completed H1 including i for the close-through and TR[i] only. Last series bar is forming (exclude_forming).
causality.range: donchian_prior: max/min of high/low on i-n .. i-1. Bar i is never inside the window. Close-through: close[i] > range_high[i] long, close[i] < range_low[i] short. Wick-beyond + close-inside is not a signal.
causality.squeeze: atr14[i-1] / atr50[i-1] <= squeeze_max. Wilder ATR. Baseline is the prior close, not ATR[i].
causality.atr: Wilder ATR14 and ATR50 on H1. SL/TP use atr14[i] at the signal bar (known at close). Floor atr<=0 skips.
causality.htf_join: none. H4 is not loaded. Do not resample. Do not add EMA bias.
causality.ema: OFF. This is the sealed v1 failure mode.
causality.edge_trigger: setup now AND NOT setup on previous closed H1 (same side).
causality.entry_close: decision on close[i]; fill is open[i+1].
causality.gap: if the next H1 open gaps through SL or TP, exit at that open (SL before TP if both).
causality.pivots: not used. Do not import htf_fib_core. Range is prior-N high/low, not fractal confirmation.
